notes.rule: when the rest site offers both resting and smithing: rest below heal_below_hp_ratio of max HP, smith from it upwards (smith only while some upgrade has a positive value; otherwise the effect scores decide); the favoured action is lifted to lead by rule_margin points
notes.source: set by hand from the player's run history (260 rest decisions, 42 runs; scripts/analyze_rest_choices.py): heal rate 79% / 70% / 39% / 18% in the HP bands 0.4 / 0.5 / 0.6 / 0.7; every half of the runs (older/newer and alternating ids) reads 0.6, and 0.6 scores 80.6-87.3% on the other half against 76.1-82.5% for 0.5
notes.not_used: the pre-boss rest site is rested at more often (HP 0.5-0.7: 70% against 39%), but a separate boss threshold did not beat the single threshold on held-out halves; elites ahead, act, potions and max HP showed no clear effect

notes.units: frontload/aoe/scaling: damage per turn; defense: block per turn; cycle: extra cards drawn per turn beyond the base hand (deck size acts through every card's draw rate, not here); energy: energy supply / energy demand
notes.needs: derived per upcoming fight from real encounter-pool HP/attack facts; only the ratios below are Guide-owned parameters
notes.fight_tempo: expected fight length relative to fight_turns = damage need / (frontload + scaling), bounded to [min, max]; the unblocked share of the defense need is multiplied by it (a faster deck takes less damage, a slower one more)
notes.confidence: card-reward confidence is low only when gaps could change the pick: a lead under near_tie_points, or a partly scored rival within confidence_gap_allowance points of the pick (each unscored part assumed worth up to that much); also low for capture warnings or an unscorable eligible card. Set by hand, not fitted. Below near_tie_points both top rows also carry a near-tie note (explanation only)
notes.pick_margin: a card is recommended only when its score beats skipping by more than pick_margin_by_act (added to skip's score). Set by hand from the player's run history (13 winning runs: skip rate 25% / 51% / 73% in acts 1 / 2 / 3) and checked on runs it was not set on; see scripts/analyze_skip_choices.py
notes.energy: energy limits how many drawn cards are played (a cap on every other dimension); its own weight is 0 so it is not counted twice
notes.orb_slots: assembly: Defect.get_BaseOrbSlotCount = 3, CharacterModel default 0; OrbCmd.Channel adds 1 slot when a player with none channels
notes.encounters: needs come from encounter and monster facts: real line-ups, per-turn attack and hits walked from each monster's move state machine; ActModel.NumberOfWeakEncounters is 3 for Overgrowth/Underdocks and 2 for Hive/Glory (the act's first normal fights use its weak pool); Frail multiplies card block by 0.75 (powers:FRAIL)

lookahead.note: Budget, not fitted: 2026-10-25 the real-time P95 needed headroom. 4 scenarios against 6 on the golden set (79) and the run history (483): best-choice hits 34/79 and 206/483 against 34/79 and 203/483, 19 of 562 picks changed, 24% less CPU.

card_reward_odds.source: assembly CardRarityOdds via AscensionHelper.GetValueIfAscension(level 7, ascension value, base value): regular common 0.6 (A7 0.615), uncommon 0.37, rare 0.03 (A7 0.0149); elite common 0.5 (A7 0.549), uncommon 0.4, rare 0.1 (A7 0.05); boss rare 1; rare offset starts at -0.05

relic_choice_v1.note: TASK-027 tickets 02 and 05, set by hand 2026-10-31. samples / max_variants: random pickup results (a transformed card, a card from a pool, a reward screen, a relic) are averaged over this many seeded samples, keeping at most this many results per option (budget for the real-time limit, not fitted; 2026-10-31 raised from 6 / 12: with 6 samples of an 80-card pool the mean of a transform swung by about two points). Every option of a decision draws the same samples from the same pool (common random numbers), so options are compared on the same random results. Between-fight effects count over the rest of the run: a deck change now counts once; one made later counts by the horizon left after it (the rest of its act plus later acts weighted by reaching them) over the horizon from now. Expected occurrences: the route's remaining fights this act, then fights_per_act (run history means per finished act: Monster 5.35 / 4.14 / 4.62, Elite 0.90 / 0.64 / 0.62, Boss 1). gold_income_per_act: gold gained per finished act in the run history (means 288 / 438 / 148), for effects that stop gold income. relic_rarity_odds: the relic rarity roll read from the IL by the TASK-027 fact reviewers (below 0.5 Common, below 0.83 Uncommon, else Rare); a random relic comes from the shared pool and the player's own. Floors per act, reaching the next act and rest heals per act come from resource_exchange_v1.

resource_exchange_v1.note: TASK-027 ticket 03, set by hand 2026-10-30 from anchors measured with the engine on the run history, not fitted to the player's choices; gains are on the policies' scale (fitness looking ahead over the act's coming rewards). Gold (scripts/analyze_gold_curve.py): at each history shop the offers' gain per gold, best deals first; gold_marginal_points_per_100_by_act is the median marginal value per band of gold_band gold spent (cards at base price and the best removal; relic deals are not in it yet and are to be added with the shop relic facts). Gold is worth what it buys at the shops ahead: shops_per_act (history means 1.20 / 1.32 / 1.25 shop visits per finished act), later acts weighted by reach_next_act (history: 40 of 46 runs finished act 1, 22 of 40 act 2), the current act by the share of its act_floors floors left. HP (scripts/analyze_resource_exchange.py): at the campfire threshold a rest heal of 30% max HP is worth about the best upgrade (median 0.06 points per HP over 234 rest sites); each HP is worth threshold / HP ratio times that, within hp_value_scale. Max HP: the heal GainMaxHp brings, plus rest_heal_share (0.3: HealRestSiteOption.GetBaseHealAmount is MaxHp x 0.3) of each point at every rest heal left in the run (rest_heals_per_act from the run history: 1.02 / 1.23 / 1.12 per finished act, later acts weighted by reach_next_act), priced at the threshold rate.
